content.body:
The A class 1917 "Steamer" was originally a British design launched in 1917, that after WWI became the generic blueprint for tramp steamers the world over. It served as a lightly armed freighter during both world wars.
Its role in Battleground Europe is to provide the means to transport vehicles and troops across coastal waters for amphibious assaults where tanks and other heavy weapons are otherwise not available for combat. It is equipped with a crane and the ability to transport 4 heavy vehicles, such as tanks, once loaded.
Infantry troops can also be transported at the same time, and it is armed with four 20 mm anti-aircraft batteries slaved together in pairs, enabling two players to multicrew as gunners controlling all 4 guns.
content.brief: TYPE: Armed Freighter MAX SPEED: 15 knots WEIGHT: 5,243 tons ARMAMENT: 20 mm Oerlikon AA cannons (4)
content.title: Type A-1917 Cargo Freighter
